cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before you send another 'fine,' tell me what you deleted. I want us to trust each other with the awkward version.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Let me be the person you can sound needy with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You first. You always sound so casual.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I check whether you've replied before I get out of bed. Will you send me your needy bit now?
